text: [159] 69 dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano . katamehi dvīhi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu no ca sutānaṃ dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthupaparikkhī hoti no ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ . imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attanoti .
